Entrance.name: Entrance
Entrance.description: A narrow hallway with a worn doormat. A coat rack stands against the wall, holding a single faded jacket. Several cardboard boxes are stacked haphazardly, some labeled 'BOOKS' and 'KITCHEN' in messy handwriting.

north.description: A short passage leading into the living room, cluttered with more boxes.

items.name: coat_rack
items.description: A wooden coat rack with a single worn jacket. The jacket has a hole in the pocket.

items.name: jacket
items.description: An old denim jacket with a broken zipper. The pocket contains a crumpled bus ticket.

items.name: bus_ticket
items.description: A used bus ticket from Millbrook Transit, dated last week.

items.name: box_books
items.description: A cardboard box overflowing with paperback novels and conspiracy theory pamphlets. The top book is 'The Turner Diaries'.

Living Area.name: Living Area
Living Area.description: A cramped living area with a sagging sofa, a small coffee table, and a bookshelf stuffed to bursting. The walls are adorned with faded posters of 80s action movies and a map of the world with several pins. A large cardboard box labeled 'SURVIVAL GEAR' sits in the corner.

east.description: A doorway into the kitchen, visible through a bead curtain.

north.description: A door leading to the bedroom, slightly ajar.

west.description: A narrow doorway to a small study crammed with books and papers.

items.name: sofa
items.description: A threadbare sofa with a suspicious stain. It might be comfortable for a short rest.

items.name: coffee_table
items.description: A low table covered in magazines, empty cups, and a half-eaten bag of chips.

items.name: chips
items.description: A crinkled bag of barbecue chips, still half full.

items.name: magazine
items.description: A conspiracy theory magazine with articles about the New World Order and chemtrails. The pages are dog-eared.

items.name: bookshelf
items.description: A floor-to-ceiling bookshelf crammed with books on history, politics, and white supremacist literature. A few volumes on Norse mythology as well.

items.name: survival_box
items.description: A large cardboard box labeled 'SURVIVAL GEAR'. It contains some camping equipment and a first aid kit.

items.name: first_aid_kit
items.description: A small plastic case with bandages, antiseptic wipes, and painkillers.

Kitchen.name: Kitchen
Kitchen.description: A small kitchen with a gas stove, a refrigerator that hums loudly, and a sink full of dirty dishes. The counters are cluttered with canned goods and boxes of instant noodles. A calendar on the wall shows a photo of a mountain landscape.

west.description: Through the bead curtain back to the living room.

down.description: A trapdoor in the floor, probably leading to a small cellar.

items.name: refrigerator
items.description: An old white refrigerator. It's humming loudly. Inside, there are some condiments, a half-empty carton of milk, and a few cans of soda.

items.name: milk
items.description: A carton of milk with an expiration date two days from now. It's still cold.

items.name: soda
items.description: A can of generic cola. It's warm now, but still fizzy.

items.name: canned_food
items.description: A stack of canned beans, soup, and vegetables. Some are rusted.

items.name: instant_noodles
items.description: Several boxes of instant ramen noodles. The cheap kind.

items.name: dirty_dishes
items.description: A pile of crusty plates and bowls in the sink. They need washing.

items.name: calendar
items.description: A wall calendar showing a beautiful mountain scene. The current month is circled in red ink.

Bedroom.name: Bedroom
Bedroom.description: A small bedroom with a single bed pushed against the wall. A nightstand holds a lamp and a stack of books. The closet door is slightly open, revealing a jumble of clothes. The walls are bare except for a large poster of a wolf howling at the moon.

south.description: The door back to the living room.

east.description: A door leading to a small bathroom.

items.name: bed
items.description: A modest single bed with rumpled sheets and a flat pillow. Looks comfortable enough for a good rest.

items.name: nightstand
items.description: A small wooden nightstand with a drawer. On top sits a lamp and a pile of books.

items.name: lamp
items.description: A small reading lamp with a dusty shade. It works when plugged in.

items.name: book_pile
items.description: A stack of books including 'Moby Dick', 'The Art of the Deal', and several romance novels.

items.name: closet
items.description: A small closet stuffed with clothes, a few empty hangers, and a shoebox on the top shelf.

items.name: shoebox
items.description: A shoebox hidden on the top shelf. Inside are some old photographs and a letter.

items.name: photograph
items.description: A faded photo of a young couple at a fair. On the back, written in pencil: 'Mom & Dad, 1995'.

items.name: letter
items.description: A handwritten letter from someone named 'Grandma', talking about family and hoping Imani is doing well.

Bathroom.name: Bathroom
Bathroom.description: A tiny bathroom with a toilet, a sink, and a shower stall. The mirror is fogged and spotted. A few towels hang on a rack. The medicine cabinet is slightly ajar.

items.name: toilet
items.description: A standard white toilet. It flushes, though the handle sticks a little.

items.name: sink
items.description: A small sink with a dripping faucet. A half-used bar of soap rests on the edge.

items.name: soap
items.description: A worn bar of soap, faintly smelling of lavender.

items.name: towel
items.description: A damp towel hanging on the rack. It's thin but usable.

items.name: medicine_cabinet
items.description: A small mirrored cabinet above the sink. Inside: a toothbrush, toothpaste, pain relievers, and some band-aids.

items.name: toothbrush
items.description: A worn toothbrush with frayed bristles.

items.name: painkillers
items.description: A bottle of ibuprofen with a few pills left.

items.name: shower
items.description: A cramped shower stall with a plastic curtain. The water pressure is weak but warm.

Study.name: Study
Study.description: A cramped room dominated by a large desk covered in papers, books, and a desktop computer. The walls are plastered with maps, newspaper clippings, and printed forum threads. A corkboard holds photos and handwritten notes connected by red string. A single chair is pushed under the desk.

east.description: Doorway back to the living room.

items.name: desk
items.description: A large wooden desk cluttered with papers, a lamp, and a computer monitor. Drawers are stuffed with notebooks.

items.name: computer
items.description: An old desktop computer with a bulky monitor. It's connected but without internet, it's just a word processor. There might be some files saved locally.

items.name: notebook
items.description: A spiral notebook filled with Imani's handwriting: poems, conspiracy theories, and rants about race. Some pages are torn.

items.name: corkboard
items.description: A corkboard covered in newspaper clippings, printed articles, and photos linked by red string. It's a classic conspiracy theorist's wall.

items.name: printer
items.description: A dusty inkjet printer. It's out of ink and paper.

items.name: books_stack
items.description: A stack of books on history and political theory, including 'The Protocols of the Elders of Zion' and 'Mein Kampf'.

items.name: coffee_mug
items.description: A chipped mug with a faded logo. It has old coffee residue at the bottom.

items.name: chair
items.description: An old swivel chair with worn padding. It's not comfortable for long periods.

Cellar.name: Cellar
Cellar.description: A small, dark cellar beneath the kitchen. It's cool and damp, with a dirt floor. Shelves line the walls, holding jars of preserved food and old paint cans. A single bare bulb hangs from the ceiling, but it doesn't work.

up.description: The trapdoor leading back up to the kitchen.

items.name: shelves
items.description: Wooden shelves lined with mason jars of pickles, jams, and canned vegetables. Also some paint cans and old tools.

items.name: pickles
items.description: A jar of homemade pickles. The brine looks murky but probably edible.

items.name: jam
items.description: A jar of strawberry jam, sealed. It's probably still good.

items.name: flashlight_old
items.description: A rusty flashlight. It might work if it had batteries.

items.name: batteries
items.description: A pack of AA batteries, still sealed. There are four.
